name: stonks-copilot
description: Agent-native investing copilot: 50/50 technical+fundamental stock analysis, portfolio X-Ray with real fund overlap from SEC N-PORT filings, SVG charts, and a decision journal that alerts when your stated thesis breaks.

stock.description: Analyze a stock 50/50: technicals + SEC fundamentals with a blended scorecard and chart

xray.description: Portfolio forensics: effective exposure, fund overlap, concentration and fees with a treemap

thesis.description: Decision journal: record an investment thesis with cited metrics, list theses, or scan for thesis breaks

interface.shortDescription: Know what you own, why you bought it, and when that reason broke.
interface.longDescription: A retail-investor copilot with three integrated loops. Analyze: 50/50 technicals (computed locally from daily OHLCV) and fundamentals (SEC EDGAR XBRL) blended into one scorecard with signal-level reasons. X-Ray: import broker positions and merge direct holdings with real fund constituents from N-PORT filings to expose overlap, effective exposure, concentration and fee drag — what you actually own, not what you bought. Journal: record theses with quantified cited metrics and get thesis-break alerts when the reason you gave stops being true. Data comes from keyless public endpoints (Stooq, SEC EDGAR) cached locally. Strictly read-only: it never places orders and never asks for broker credentials.
